welcome.title: Statistics, calmly.
welcome.lead: A modern workspace for the PSPP statistics engine. Let’s set it up for you in about a minute.
welcome.point1: No installation. Descriptives, tests, regression and charts.
welcome.point2Title: Your data stay on your computer
welcome.point2: Nothing is uploaded. Files are processed locally.
welcome.point3: Plain-language explanations next to the tables.
